title: Transfer among federal courts
summary: Transfer moves litigation from one federal district to another under statutory authority. Different statutes address a convenient alternative to a proper venue, an improper venue, and coordinated pretrial proceedings.
notes: Hoffman interprets an earlier statutory formulation; the casebook discusses later consent language. Transfer can also affect the choice-of-law analysis, and an ordinary transfer and an Atlantic Marine forum-clause transfer require careful distinction.

sections.Meaning: Transfer moves litigation from one federal district to another under statutory authority. Different statutes address a convenient alternative to a proper venue, an improper venue, and coordinated pretrial proceedings.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the statute before evaluating destination and convenience. Under § 1404, examine eligibility, the relevant interests, and any valid forum clause. Under § 1406, address the defect in venue. Consider the distinct treatment of multidistrict proceedings under § 1407.
